title: Exorcists facing Revelation
summary: How a demon hunter withstands a demon’s true form.

claims.text: A demon hunter with strong religious conviction, Christian or otherwise, may get a lower difficulty on Willpower rolls against a demon’s Revelation, or be spared the roll altogether.
Some hunters never resist at all and stand frozen in awe or fall to worship, and many exorcists lose their reason at the sight before their war even begins.

title: Researching demons
summary: Finding usable lore on prayers and relics.

claims.text: Digging up prayers, blessed relics and reliable demon lore takes Intelligence + Research, or Intelligence + Occult at the Storyteller’s choice, and hours to weeks of work.

Difficulty depends on the sources: 6 or less with church ties and a rich demonology library, 7 for a large city library, 8 for a small town library or private collection, and 9 or 10 for the lies and rumours of the Internet.
